heading.en: Birth, marriage and the eve of accession

body.zh-Hant: 維托里奧·埃馬努埃萊三世於1869年11月11日生於那不勒斯，父為翁貝托一世、母為瑪格麗特。他二十歲起從軍、升遷迅速，1890年已是上校；1896年10月24日與黑山的埃萊娜成婚。1900年7月29日翁貝托一世遇刺時，他與妻子正在希臘乘遊艇航行，隨後經雷焦卡拉布里亞趕往蒙察。
body.en: Vittorio Emanuele III was born in Naples on 11 November 1869, son of Umberto I and Margherita. He began a rapid army career at twenty and was already a colonel in 1890; on 24 October 1896 he married Elena of Montenegro. When Umberto I was assassinated on 29 July 1900 he and his wife were on a yacht cruise in Greece, and they went on via Reggio di Calabria to Monza.

citations.quote: nacque da Umberto I e Margherita di Savoia l’11 novembre 1869 a Napoli
A venti anni iniziò una rapida carriera militare (nel 1890 era già colonnello)
il 24 ottobre 1896 si celebrarono le nozze
La scelta cadde su Elena del Montenegro
Quando Umberto I fu assassinato (29 luglio 1900)
erano in crociera in Grecia a bordo del loro yacht Yela
Da lì raggiunsero Reggio di Calabria e poi Monza.

heading.zh-Hant: 從即位到第一次世界大戰
heading.en: Accession to the First World War

body.zh-Hant: 繼位後，薩拉科內閣於1901年2月倒台，他改召中間偏左領袖扎納爾代利組閣，扎氏任命喬利蒂為內政部長；國王與喬利蒂合作了十四年。1911年義大利發動利比亞戰役。1915年4月26日義大利以《倫敦條約》加入協約國；他常赴前線，因此得「軍人國王」之稱，並在卡波雷托戰敗之後才下令以迪亞茲取代總參謀長卡多爾納。
body.en: After his accession, when Saracco's government fell in February 1901 he called the centre-left leader Zanardelli, who made Giolitti interior minister; king and Giolitti worked together for fourteen years. Italy fought the Libyan campaign in 1911. Italy joined the Entente by the Pact of London on 26 April 1915; he often went to the front, earning the nickname 'soldier king', and ordered Chief of Staff Cadorna replaced by Diaz only after the defeat at Caporetto.

citations.quote: Caduto il governo di Saracco (febbraio 1901)
chiamando Giuseppe Zanardelli – leader del centrosinistra
nominò al ministero degli Interni Giovanni Giolitti
ma collaborarono per quattordici anni
come mostrò la campagna di Libia del 1911
si legarono all’Intesa con il Patto di Londra (26 aprile 1915)
Si recava di frequente al fronte (da qui il soprannome di ‘re soldato’)
la sostituzione del capo di stato maggiore Luigi Cadorna con Armando Diaz
solo dopo la sconfitta di Caporetto

body.zh-Hant: 1922年10月，總理法克塔上呈戒嚴令請國王簽署，國王卻拒簽並決定組新政府，委任墨索里尼組閣。1925年12月至1926年1月間他簽署了「最法西斯法」。1936年他被宣布為皇帝。1938年3月參議院設「帝國第一元帥」一階，同時授予領袖與國王，國王對此等同待遇一度威脅不簽。
body.en: In October 1922 Prime Minister Facta brought him the state-of-siege decree to sign, but the king refused and decided to form a new government, charging Mussolini with forming it. Between December 1925 and January 1926 he signed the 'leggi fascistissime'. In 1936 he was proclaimed emperor. In March 1938 the Senate created the rank of First Marshal of the Empire and conferred it on both Mussolini and the king; the king threatened not to sign the law over this equal footing.

citations.quote: Quando, nel 1922, Mussolini preparò la marcia delle camicie nere su Roma
il primo ministro, nella notte del 26 ottobre
Il mattino dopo Facta si presentò da Vittorio Emanuele per la firma sul decreto
lo sorprese con un rifiuto e con la decisione di formare un nuovo governo

Tra il dicembre del 1925 e il gennaio del 1926
il re Vittorio Emanuele firmò le ‘leggi fascistissime’

La tensione crebbe nel marzo del 1938
il Senato creò il grado di primo maresciallo dell’Impero

Vittorio Emanuele minacciò di non firmare la legge

heading.zh-Hant: 第二次世界大戰與墨索里尼倒台
heading.en: Second World War and the fall of Mussolini

body.zh-Hant: 1939年4月義大利迅速併吞阿爾巴尼亞；同年5月底簽署《鋼鐵盟約》。1943年7月25日法西斯大議會通過格蘭迪議案，國王隨即把墨索里尼交由憲兵拘押，由巴多利奧出任政府首腦。9月3日他簽署無條件投降；其後國王在夜裡離開羅馬，南下避難。
body.en: In April 1939 Italy rapidly annexed Albania; in late May the Pact of Steel was signed. On 25 July 1943 the Fascist Grand Council approved the Grandi motion; the king had Mussolini taken into custody by the carabinieri, and Pietro Badoglio became head of government. On 3 September he signed the unconditional surrender; the king then left Rome in the middle of the night for the south.

citations.quote: Nell’aprile ’39 l’Italia annesse rapidamente l’Albania.
A fine maggio
fu sottoscritto il Patto d’acciaio
lo sbarco alleato in Sicilia (9 luglio 1943)
Il 25 luglio il Gran Consiglio del fascismo approvò l’ordine del giorno Grandi
lo fece prendere in custodia dai carabinieri
Pietro Badoglio andò a capo del governo
il 3 settembre, Vittorio Emanuele firmò la resa incondizionata
Nel cuore della notte Vittorio Emanuele lasciò Roma, per riparare al Sud.

body.zh-Hant: 1944年6月5日，他把全部權力與特殊的「王國中將」（luogotenente del Regno）職位交給太子翁貝托，自己僅保留名義上的國王身分。1946年5月9日（制度公投前夕）他退位，其後自願流亡亞歷山大港，1947年12月28日去世。
body.en: On 5 June 1944 he handed all powers and the anomalous post of lieutenant-general of the realm (luogotenente del Regno) to Umberto, remaining king in name only. He abdicated on 9 May 1946, on the eve of the institutional referendum, then went into voluntary exile in Alexandria, Egypt, where he died on 28 December 1947.

citations.quote: assegnando (5 giugno 1944) tutti i poteri
l’anomala carica di luogotenente del Regno a Umberto
di rimanere re solo nominalmente
il re abdicò il 9 maggio 1946 (a ridosso del referendum istituzionale)
Scelse poi l’esilio volontario ad Alessandria d’Egitto
Morì il 28 dicembre 1947

body.zh-Hant: 純宗（名坧，字君邦，號正軒）1874年2月生，為高宗與明成皇后的次子，次年2月被冊封為王世子，1882年娶閔氏為世子嬪。1897年大韓帝國建立後，他被冊封為皇太子。
body.en: Sunjong (personal name Cheok, courtesy name Gunbang, art name Jeongheon) was born in February 1874, second son of Gojong and Empress Myeongseong; the following February he was invested as royal heir, and in 1882 he took a Min lady as crown princess. When the Korean Empire was founded in 1897 he was made crown prince.

citations.quote: 1874년 2월 고종과 명성황후(明成皇后) 의 둘째 아들로 태어났다
이름은 척(坧), 자는 군방(君邦), 호는 정헌(正軒)이다
출생 다음해 2월에 왕세자로 책봉되었고
1882년에 민씨를 세자빈으로 맞았다
1897년 대한제국 의 수립에 따라 황태자로 책봉되었다

heading.zh-Hant: 即位與名存實亡的統治

body.zh-Hant: 1907年7月日本強迫高宗退位，純宗即位為大韓帝國皇帝，改年號隆熙，並把居所由德壽宮遷往昌德宮。即位後不久日本強制簽訂《韓日新協約》，使日本統監得以干預國政；韓國軍隊被強制解散，1909年7月又以《己酉覺書》奪走司法權。該條目評他是失去實權的傀儡皇帝。1910年8月29日《韓日併合條約》成立，大韓帝國滅亡。
body.en: In July 1907 Japan forced Gojong to abdicate and Sunjong took the throne as Emperor of the Korean Empire, changing the era name to Yunghui and moving his residence from Deoksugung to Changdeokgung. Soon after his accession Japan forced through the New Korea–Japan Agreement, letting the Japanese resident-general interfere across government; the remaining Korean army was forcibly disbanded, and in July 1909 the Giyu Memorandum took away judicial power. The entry judges him an emperor without real power. The annexation treaty took effect on 29 August 1910, ending the Korean Empire.

citations.quote: 1907년 7월에 일제가 강제로 고종 을 퇴위시키면서 대한제국의 황제로 즉위하였다
대한제국의 황제로 즉위하여 연호를 융희(隆熙)로 고쳤다
거처를 덕수궁에서 창덕궁으로 옮겼다
순종이 즉위한 직후인 1907년 7월 일제는 이른바 한일신협약(韓日新協約) 을 강제 체결하여
국정 전반을 일본인 통감이 간섭할 수 있게 하였다
얼마 남지 않았던 한국 군대를 재정 부족이라는 구실로 강제 해산시켜
1909년 7월에는 기유각서(己酉覺書) 주3 에 의해 사법권마저 강탈해 버렸다
이처럼 순종은 실권을 상실한 허수아비 황제였다
1910년 8월 29일에 이른바 한일병합조약 을 성립시켜 대한제국을 멸망시켰다

heading.en: Demotion to King Yi and death

body.zh-Hant: 大韓帝國滅亡後，純宗由皇帝降為王，被稱為「昌德宮李王」，王位虛號被安排世襲。他被廢後一直居住在昌德宮，1926年4月25日去世。
body.en: After the Korean Empire ended, Sunjong was demoted from emperor to king and called the 'King Yi of Changdeok Palace', the empty royal title being arranged to pass by inheritance. Deposed, he lived in Changdeokgung until he died on 25 April 1926.

citations.quote: 순종은 황제의 위에서 왕으로 강등되었다
'창덕궁(昌德宮) 이왕(李王)'으로 불렸고
왕위의 허호(虛號)는 세습되게 조처되었다
폐위된 순종은 창덕궁에 거처하다가 1926년 4월 25일에 사망하였다

body.zh-Hant: 埃及政治人物阿里·馬赫爾帕夏，1936年出任內閣總理，其後任王室內閣首長，1939年8月組第二次內閣。義大利參戰後，他設法讓埃及保持絕對中立，與英國利益及部分埃及輿論衝突，因此1940年6月被迫辭職。1942年4月他因涉嫌親軸心國被拘禁，1945年獲釋。
body.en: Egyptian politician. President of the Council of Ministers in 1936, then chief of the royal cabinet, he formed his second ministry in August 1939. After Italy entered the war he tried to hold Egypt to strict neutrality, against British interests and part of Egyptian opinion, and so had to resign in June 1940. In April 1942 he was interned on suspicion of Axis sympathies and was freed in 1945.

people.name: António Ginestal Machado
people.nameZh: 安東尼奧·吉內斯塔爾·馬沙多

body.zh-Hant: 安東尼奧·吉內斯塔爾·馬沙多是教師、政論作者與共和派政治家，1874年5月3日生於阿爾梅達，1940年6月28日卒於桑塔雷姆。他1895年畢業於海軍學校、1897年修畢高等文學課程，放棄海軍軍官生涯而從事教職，並於1911至1923年任桑塔雷姆國立中學校長。1912年加入共和聯盟，其後屬自由黨（1919–1923），再入其後繼者民族黨並任該黨執行委員會主席（1923–1927）。他連任三屆桑塔雷姆議員（1921–1926），1921年任教育部長，1923年任部長會議主席。
body.en: Ginestal Machado was a teacher, publicist and republican statesman, born in Almeida on 3 May 1874 and died in Santarém on 28 June 1940. He graduated from the Naval School (1895) and the Curso Superior de Letras (1897), gave up a naval career for teaching, and was rector of the Santarém national lyceum 1911–1923. He joined the União Republicana in 1912, then the Liberal Party (1919–23) and its successor the Nationalist Party, whose directorate he chaired (1923–27). He was deputy for Santarém in three consecutive legislatures (1921–26), minister of education in 1921 and President of the Council of Ministers in 1923.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身、求學與早期政治生涯
heading.en: Origins, schooling and early political career

body.zh-Hant: 羅斯福1882年生於紐約海德帕克，十四歲被送入格羅頓學校，後入哈佛學院，1905年在紐約市與愛蓮娜結婚。他1910年當選紐約州參議員，1912年連任；1913年進入威爾遜政府任海軍助理部長；1920年被民主黨提名為副總統候選人。
body.en: Franklin Delano Roosevelt was born in 1882 in Hyde Park, New York. At 14 his parents sent him to the Groton School, and he went on to Harvard College; he married Eleanor in New York City in 1905. He won election to the New York State Senate in 1910 and was re-elected in 1912; in 1913 he joined the Wilson administration as assistant secretary of the Navy; in 1920 the party named him its vice-presidential candidate.

heading.zh-Hant: 小兒麻痺、紐約州長與當選總統

body.zh-Hant: 1921年羅斯福罹患小兒麻痺，雙腿癱瘓；1920年代他把相當部分家產投入整修喬治亞州溫泉鎮的療養地。1928年他贏得紐約州長，1930年連任；1932年大蕭條加劇，民主黨推他挑戰胡佛總統，他以壓倒性票數當選。
body.en: Roosevelt contracted polio in 1921 and was left paralysed in his legs; he invested a considerable part of his fortune in rehabilitating a spa at Warm Springs, Georgia. He won the governorship of New York in 1928 and was re-elected in 1930. With the Depression worse by 1932 the Democrats turned to him to challenge President Hoover, and he was swept into office in a landslide.

body.zh-Hant: 他在就職演說中告訴美國人「唯一值得恐懼的就是恐懼本身」。上任後的「百日新政」推動銀行金融改革，並以電台「爐邊談話」安撫公眾。1935年新政轉向更自由主義的方向，通過《華格納法》與《社會安全法》。羅斯福在1936、1940、1944年三度連任，為美國史上唯一。義大利百科條目另指出，他延攬專家組成「智囊團」，並選柯德爾·赫爾為國務卿。
body.en: In his inaugural address he told Americans they had 'nothing to fear but fear itself'. In the First Hundred Days FDR pushed through legislation reforming banking and finance, and his radio 'fireside chats' calmed the public. In 1935 the New Deal turned in a more liberal direction with the Wagner Act and the Social Security Act. He was re-elected in 1936, 1940 and 1944, a unique case in US history. The Italian encyclopedia adds that he surrounded himself with expert advisers (the 'Brains Trust') and chose Cordell Hull as secretary of state.

body.zh-Hant: 1940至1941年間，羅斯福對抵抗納粹的英國提供大量援助。1941年12月7日日本偷襲珍珠港，美國正式參戰；到1943年，美軍與盟國已扭轉對德日的戰局。1945年4月，在德國投降前數週，他因腦出血去世。義大利百科條目記他在美國參戰很久以前就向國會發表「四大自由」咨文。
body.en: In 1940 and 1941 Roosevelt extended massive aid to Great Britain as it held out against Nazi Germany. Japan's surprise attack on Pearl Harbor on 7 December 1941 brought the United States into the war; by 1943 the US military and its allies had turned the tide against Germany and Japan. In April 1945, weeks before the German surrender, he died of a cerebral hemorrhage. The Italian encyclopedia notes his Four Freedoms message to Congress, well before the US entered the war.
